question_text: A government employee's monthly salary was P25,000. She received a 12% salary increase. What is her new monthly salary?

hint_ladder.title: Hanapin ang Dagdag Dapat
hint_ladder.text: Ang 12% increase ay nangangahulugang dadagdagan ang orihinal ng 12% nito. Una, alamin kung magkano ang 12% ng P25,000.

hint_ladder.title: Simpleng Porsyento Rules
hint_ladder.text: Para makuha ang 12% ng kahit anong numero, i-multiply ang numero sa 0.12. Dito, 0.12 x 25,000.

hint_ladder.title: Komputin ang Dagdag
hint_ladder.text: 0.12 x 25,000 = 3,000. Ang P3,000 ay ang dagdag. Ngayon, idagdag mo ito sa orihinal na P25,000.

hint_ladder.title: Malapit Ka Na!
hint_ladder.text: P25,000 (orihinal) + P3,000 (dagdag) = P28,000. Ito ang bagong sweldo! Aling opsyon ang tumutugma?

A.text: You might have chosen A because you used 8% instead of 12%, giving an increase of P2,000, which added to P25,000 gives P27,000.

B.text: You might have chosen B because you mistakenly used 10% instead of 12%, getting a P2,500 raise resulting in P27,500.

C.text: Correct. 12% of P25,000 is P3,000, so the new salary is P28,000.

D.text: You might have chosen D because you used 14% instead of 12%, giving a P3,500 raise resulting in P28,500.

next_time_rule: For percentage increase: original x (1 + decimal) = new amount. For 12%, use 1.12: P25,000 x 1.12 = P28,000.
deconstruct_text:
Isipin mo yung jeepney fare na P13. Nagkaroon ng 12% increase. Paano kukuwentahin? Ganun din sa sweldo: P25,000 x 0.12 = P3,000 dagdag. Kaya bagong sweldo: P25,000 + P3,000 = P28,000.

Mental trick: 'Dagdag-sweldo shortcut' — original x (1 + decimal). For 12% increase, gawin 1.12. So 25,000 x 1.12 = 28,000 agad! Para 'to sa mabilisang exam.
